items.title: google-deepmind/mujoco
items.contentSnippet:
Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
https://mujoco.org

  
 
             
 
MuJoCo stands for Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment.
 
This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind.
 
MuJ

items.title: Show HN: NoDOM high performance WASM UI kit for DuckDB-WASM
items.contentSnippet: NoDOM replaces Chrome's DOM, CSS & HTML rendering with a custom WASM engine designed for high performance and minimal latency in Modern Data Oriented C++ for a zero alloc zero copy render hotpath. The aim being to minimise tick-to-render latency. GUI layout and data declarative JSON are served via websocket after initial page load, or can be packaged in an HTML shell like the UK property demo. items.contentSnippet:

items.title: Show HN: ThingStudio, Node-RED style programming for microcontrollers
items.contentSnippet:
Hi, I'm Mike,
I've made ThingStudio, a flow programing environment for microcontrollers. It allows drag and drop programming Node-RED style, but emits MicroPython which it uploads to the micro. The board does not need the editor to run after that. Runs fully local, Apache 2 licensed.
There's a functional version of the editor/IDE at linked to the home page, you'll need to install to be able to upload, because WebSerial is not universal.
Please give it a whirl. I'm happy to answer any questions.
